professionalSummary: Onboarded fourteen distribution‑centre sites across four customers onto the scheduling product, tracking each site’s milestones in the onboarding tracker.
Ran the quarterly health check with each of nine assigned customers, walking through slot utilisation and open tickets and recording agreed actions in the account notes.

Automated slot allocation was in use at 21 of 32 assigned sites at the end of Q2, up from 12 of 32 at the end of Q4 the previous year, according to the customer success adoption dashboard against the team’s quarterly baseline of 12 sites.
Coordinated escalations with support and product through the escalation board; fixes and roadmap commitments were decided by the product manager.
Wrote the quarter‑end account notes for each customer, listing open limitations and hand‑over points for the account manager.
